testCase.input: When a configured `api_key_cmd` emits continuous or unexpectedly large stdout/stderr, both streams are appended without limit for up to 30 seconds, so the process can consume gigabytes and be killed before the timeout fires. Cap the retained output while continuing to drain both pipes.
